overview_description.description:
Finaloop is the financial operating system built for DTC, ecommerce, and retail brands. We replace your accounting software and service, inventory management system, and profit analytics tool - giving you full visibility across your business in one unified solution.
Get fully reconciled, GAAP-ready financials and real-time insights to make smarter, faster decisions and drive profitable growth - without the complexity or cost of an ERP.
From startups to large enterprise, Finaloop helps you scale while staying lean by automating 90% of your financial and operational workflows.

product.name: Ecommerce Accounting Software and Bookkeeping Services
product.description: A cloud-based ecommerce accounting platform combined with expert bookkeeping services providing real-time, accurate financial statements and bookkeeping for DTC, multichannel, and wholesale sellers.

product.name: InventoryIQ
product.description: An inventory and COGS management system that automates real-time tracking of inventory, purchase orders, vendor balances, and landed costs integrated with ecommerce financials.

product.name: Tax Services
product.description: Tax preparation and filing services including federal and state returns, tax optimization, and support, integrated with Finaloop’s tax-ready bookkeeping.

product.name: Fractional CFO Services
product.description: Access to ecommerce-focused fractional CFOs who provide monthly financial reviews and strategic advice to support business growth.
